title: We Found the COOLEST TECH at CES 2020
description:
Time for some CES 2020 highlights! Doug has the rundown on the coolest tech and best new products at CES Las Vegas 2020. Let's take a look at the best new TVs (a Sharp See-Through TV!), the latest in smart home for 2020 (the Square Off Smart Chessboard!), the best new electric cars for 2020 (the surprise Sony Vision-S concept car!), and the just plain awesome tech (the adorable Crosley Mini Cruiser Portable 3" Turntable and Royole Flexible AMOLED Display).
